record_title: Maximum Frobenius dimension of quasi-hereditary Nakayama algebras
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The theorem is stated for connected basic finite-dimensional Nakayama algebras over an algebraically closed field.
The result addresses the extremal quasi-hereditary question only; it does not resolve the separate finite-global-dimension lower-bound question from the same source.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full text of arXiv:2607.15999 was not inspected; its abstract and indexed descriptions are the principal remaining literature risk.
